def count_people_with_white_hats(image_path):
    # Read the image
    image = imageio.imread(image_path)
    
    # Detect people in the image
    bounding_boxes = []
    for object_dict in object_detector_tool.execute(image=image, labels=["people"], threshold=0.35, model_size="tiny", padding=20)[0]:
